### Test Coverage Summary

The test module [`TestRoofRetryPrompts`](file:///C:/Users/lefpa/Downloads/QGIS-AI/stratum_ro/test/test_roof_retry.py#L14) defines 8 deterministic, pure-Python unit test cases using synthetic 100×100 raster grids at 1.0 m resolution:

1. **`test_seed_lies_inside_child_geometry_and_image_not_distant_parent`**: Verifies that generated seeds lie strictly within the child candidate geometry and the image raster footprint, never in a distant parent geometry.
2. **`test_class6_supported_neutral_elevated_roof_produces_seed`**: Validates seed extraction when elevated pixels ($h \ge 2.0\text{ m}$) have class 6 LiDAR building support and neutral roof optical values ($\text{saturation} \le 0.30$, $\max \ge 60$).
3. **`test_red_elevated_roof_supported_class6_produces_seed`**: Validates seed extraction and color metrics for terracotta/red roof optical values ($R-G > 20$, $R-B > 15$) with class 6 support.
4. **`test_vegetation_only_tall_patch_yields_no_supported_roof_seed`**: Ensures tall vegetation canopy returns status `NO_SUPPORTED_ROOF_SEED` with empty seeds even if assigned class 6 support.
5. **`test_terrain_with_no_class6_yields_no_seed`**: Verifies that ground surfaces lacking LiDAR building class evidence produce no seed.
6. **`test_outside_image_yields_reason_outside_image`**: Tests that geometries placed outside the raster extents return `status: NO_SUPPORTED_ROOF_SEED` with `reason: OUTSIDE_IMAGE`.
7. **`test_input_immutability`**: Asserts that input RGB, nDSM, and building class arrays along with Shapely geometry objects remain unmodified.
8. **`test_invalid_geometry_rejected`**: Validates that non-polygons, empty geometries, `None`, MultiPolygons, and self-intersecting invalid geometries raise `ValueError`.
